project.visitorDecision: Choose the actual scheduled rocket, locate its published launch origin and decide what must be confirmed before a legal public viewing trip.
project.primaryAction: Select a mission in the first-screen Flight Desk and inspect official viewing/access sources and its pad marker before traveling.

claims.subject: weather-context

decisionState.sourceOfTruth: One /api/rocket-launch-usa response; app.js is the only mission fetch and validates all hero/map/native-picker selections before loading; flight desk is read-only derived model.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: Unavailable/held/stale sources label the decision unknown or not cleared, disable mission/map selection when no selected UUID, retain static coast/official range links; no invented GO.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show A's name, local scheduled target, LL2 origin qualifier, unverified official access and scoped NWS sky status.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Published third-party schedule is not launch authorization.

scenarios.input: Use hero mission selector to choose B with day-only time
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Switch to B across hero/map/existing selector and show time TBD instead of a false midnight countdown.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No plan-ready timing can be inferred from a day-only entry.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: A's original ID, time, pad source qualifier and regional source links return unchanged; map and original selector follow.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No stale B info may survive on the active mission.

scenarios.input: Disable scripts at the national page
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: A readable question, three source-evidence caveats, coast navigation and official range links remain available.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Static HTML makes no claim that a current mission is confirmed.

scenarios.input: Block CARTO and OSM or the Leaflet library
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The native region selector and evidence cards still work; the focus action routes to usable coast buttons.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No guessed rocket position or public driving directions appear.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show overdue/unavailable; disable the map action on 502; never display a current positive GO state.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Existing data is invalidated, not silently reused.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The Flight Desk states that no public launch viewing venue has been verified.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: A range center or pad cannot be used as visitor directions.

scenarios.input: Select Texas mission while official city source reports a closure
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Beach closure is described as dated official report and visitors are directed to official rules.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: A generally open beach never overrides launch/test exclusion controls.

failures.no-js: Static landing question, honest no-verified-current-status text, native anchor to coast selection, already printed official source links and map-independent visitor guidance.
failures.no-tiles: Use region and native mission selection without Leaflet; map focus lands on the region buttons and links instead of showing blank/map-only advice.
failures.no-image: Keep launch decision text, anchor controls, source descriptions and photo credits visible; existing historical hero photo never represents the selected launch.
failures.stale-data: Announce schedule check overdue or unavailable and keep source limitations; no old launch mission offered as a fresh decision.

qa.scopeNote: Source-only design and model tests are not actual browser screenshots. Mark PASSED only after Chromium fixture and screenshot artifact evidence is inspected.
